name: AI Generation
description: Image and video generation via configurable AI provider. Models are defined in configuration, never in code. Video generation is async with polling.
description_cn: 图像与视频生成，基于可配置的 AI 供应商。模型在配置文件中定义，不硬编码在代码中。视频生成异步轮询。

credentials.name: ai_api_key
credentials.description_en: API key for the configured generation provider (shared with ai_inference)
credentials.description_cn: 生成供应商的 API 密钥（与 ai_inference 共用）

directives.description: Generate an image from a text prompt.
directives.description_cn: 根据文本提示词生成图像。

directives.usage_cn: 视频;生成,<提示词>[,<尺寸>[,<质量>]]
directives.description: Submit an async video generation task. Returns task ID for polling.
directives.description_cn: 提交异步视频生成任务。返回任务 ID 供轮询。

directives.description: Poll the status of an async video generation task.
directives.description_cn: 轮询异步视频生成任务的状态。
